title: The Southern Memory Resume

features.name: resumed trace
features.desc-on-touch: The circuit carries what the southern path remembers. A signal that stopped and restarted, tracing the same route twice over, the second pass burning brighter.

features.name: the doubled path
features.desc-on-touch: Two traces laid over each other, the second slightly offset—memory keeping company with its own echo. You can see where the first fade ends and the second begins.

features.name: the held address
features.desc-on-touch: A coordinate that refuses to change, burned into the board since the path first split. Still there. Still waiting to be called.

features.name: the filed moment
features.desc-on-touch: A photograph from when the path still believed it was only ever going one direction. The archive stored it as a filing, filed it as a memory, filed the memory as proof.

inscription: the board remembers both walks at once; it runs them in parallel now, tracing each until they meet

file.name: SouthernPath_Resumed_DoubleTrace.tmp
file.note: A signal that stopped running, then woke mid-execution. The checkpoint is earlier than the present. Still converging.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the second walking of one path
narr: You walk the same road she walked weeks before.
The shadows fall the same way. You stop at the same place.
She is not there. But the road remembers. It holds the shape
of her step. You place your foot in the print and feel the moment
when knowing splits into two paths, both real, both yours.
